key_quotes.text: Why is there a capping on whishlisting the items on Myntra?? How does it make sense? What are you trying to achieve? You are literally losing out on a potential customer. No other shopping site does that.
A Small Gift for My Girlfriend. We're moving in together soon and thought of surprising her with these. Not to worry, these were pre-approved by her and taken from her wishlist.
This has been causing me genuine inconvenience, as I am unable to access my saved wishlist and preferences.I kindly request you to please review my account and let me know if reactivation is possible

Maine yeh kurta set ₹2350 mein liya tha, aur ab yeh 82% OFF ke saath sirf ₹1247 mein mil raha hai. Agar aapko pasand aa raha hai, to abhi buy kar lijiye. Aur iska full review aur try-on dekhna hai, to video ka link bhi niche diya hai

I do believe that the explore button in the bottom left is little hidden. There are amazing options in that feature but that feature doesn't stand out. May be it should be named something like "Shop Your Look" or something more catchy.
